name: mood-music
description: Tell it how you feel, or name a song that moved you. A DJ agent finds songs with the same feeling and plays them: YouTube inside the page, bilibili in a new browser tab. Like or skip, and the next picks follow.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Say how you feel, or name a song that moved you — it finds more with the same feeling
Every pick says why it fits the mood
YouTube plays inside the page through the privacy-enhanced embed
bilibili songs open in a new tab of your own browser; the agent never touches your account
Like or skip a song, and the next picks use it
The background and motion follow the mood, in light and dark
useCases: Find and play songs that match how you feel right now, and keep a history of the moments that moved you.
configuration: No account is needed. YouTube plays in the page; bilibili opens in your own browser, signed in or not, as you choose.
